Sam (ACME): Hey team — after the 03/16 release (rollout/2026-03-16-4) our integration is suddenly getting wrong args in function calls. Some calls are missing the 'customer_id' field and in others the 'address' and 'postal_code' fields are swapped. This started ~10:12am UTC.

Jordan (Support): Sorry to hear that, Sam. Can you paste one example request/response and the request_id so we can trace? Also which model/version are you using?

Sam (ACME): Request id: req_0a9f33c2. Using model: redwood-3b-v1.2 (we pinned it in the API request). Example convo payload we sent to /v1/chat: ````json
{
  "model": "redwood-3b-v1.2",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Find address for acct 1234"}],
  "functions": [{"name":"lookup_address","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"address":{"type":"string"},"postal_code":{"type":"string"}}}}]
}```
And the tool invocation we got back (from your API): ````json
{
  "tool": "lookup_address",
  "args": {"address":"941 Market St","customer_id":null,"postal_code":"94103"}
}```
Notice customer_id is null and the address/postal_code mapping looks right in this case, but in other traces they were swapped (postal in address).

Jordan (Support): Thanks — passing to oncall + runtime. @Mira Oncall can you pick this up?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout rollout/2026-03-16-4 completed at 2026-03-16T10:00:00Z on dedicated cluster eu-west-1 (canary=20%).

Mira Oncall: I'm pulling logs for req_0a9f33c2. Any chance ACME is using an older function schema locally? We should check the function signature that the model saw at inference time vs what was registered.

Kevin (Runtime): Looking at server logs for req_0a9f33c2: model_instance=redwood-3b-v1.2-canary-045. I see we applied a small change in the function-arg marshaling layer in the canary: positional->named mapping fallback was modified to prefer schema field order rather than explicit names when keys are missing. That could cause swaps when model emits args without explicit keys. Snippet from inference log: ````text
INFER_OUT: tools.call(name=lookup_address, args=["94103","941 Market St", null])
MARSHAL: mapped args -> {"address":"94103","postal_code":"941 Market St","customer_id":null}
````

Mira Oncall: That explains the swap. The model on some turns emits an arg list instead of an object; older marshaler used names first, new canary prioritized field order, causing address<->postal_code flip.

Tia (PM): This is a behavior change after rollout — customer-facing regression. We should rollback the canary mapping change and patch quickly. Estimated impact?

Kevin (Runtime): Canary is 20% in eu-west-1 only per deploy-bot. I can push a hotfix to restore previous marshaling behavior within the hour and then re-run a narrow canary. Recommend rollback for that canary variant immediately.

Jordan (Support): Sam — we found a root cause: a canary change to how positional args are interpreted. We're rolling that canary back now. I'll update you once we confirm fixes. Would you be able to run a quick smoke test after we confirm?

Sam (ACME): Yes please. We'll hold traffic for 15 mins once you say go. Thanks for the quick triage. :pray:

deploy-bot: Action: rollback rollout/2026-03-16-4 -> initiated by Kevin (Runtime) at 2026-03-16T10:18:20Z.

Mira Oncall: After rollback confirmed on eu-west-1, I validated the same request id locally and args mapping returned correct: ````json
{
  "tool":"lookup_address",
  "args":{"customer_id":"acct-1234","address":"941 Market St","postal_code":"94103"}
}
````

Jordan (Support): Sam, can you re-run your failing request when you're ready? We'll monitor.

Sam (ACME): Re-ran at 10:28am UTC — now looks good. Thanks all.

Tia (PM): We'll schedule a RCA and follow-up release plan. Assigning to Kevin + Mira to prepare mitigation and a smaller, spec-conformant marshaler change if needed.

Kevin (Runtime): Will prepare patch + unit tests to prefer explicit named keys when present and only fall back to positional order if absolutely necessary. Also add an integration test for mixed positional/object outputs.

Jordan (Support): Closing loop with ACME and will log the incident in postmortems. Sam, let us know if anything else crops up.

Sam (ACME): All good for now — appreciate the quick rollback.
